As that is when it first appears, its base health could not be seen for longer periods of time. |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (3.5) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Ducky Unit''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[D00M's Revenge]] as part of the [[Duck Hunt Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned again in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It had a very high amount of health, which increased over time, but it had a above average speed. ==Appearance== The '''Ducky Unit''' is an extremely oversized yellow duck with a tiny head, black eyes, and an orange beak and feet. Its body is significantly larger than the average ducky enemy. It also wears a camouflaged helmet. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[D00M's Revenge]] is listed instead. *The [[Minigunner]], [[Ranger]] and [[Accelerator]] can easily deal with the '''Ducky Unit'''. **You can also use the [[Commander]] to decrease their firerate. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseDRDuckyUnit.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LegacyDuckyUnitIconIG.png|'''Ducky Unit''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Ducky Unit's''' name and size is a reference to the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/absolute-unit Absolute Unit] meme. *The helmet worn by the '''Ducky Unit''' is the {{RLinkC|10911958|WWII Infantry Helmet}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== *'''17 April 2022''' - [[v1.2.0]] **'''Ducky Unit''' added. *'''28 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.4]] **'''Ducky Unit''' removed. *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **'''Ducky Unit''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Ducky Unit (Ducky Revenge)|Ducky Unit]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from the [[Ducky Revenge Event]]. ==Notes== {{D00MRevenge2|[[Long Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Long Ducky]]
